agent.problem: The walkthrough leaves out an important part of Ezekiel 14:11: the house of Israel will no longer defile themselves with all their transgressions. Card 13 covers no longer straying from God, and card 14 moves directly to Israel being His people and God being their God, so this part of the LORD's stated purpose is never told or asked.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

human.problem: The two blanks in 'a ___ and a ___' read just as well in either order. A baker who picks 'proverb' then 'sign' could fairly argue they got it right, but the card only accepts 'sign' in blank 1 and 'proverb' in blank 2.
human.question: When two blanks can take the right answers in either order, should both orders count as right, or should the card be reworded so only one order fits?
